## FibroScan – Standard Use Manual

### Introduction

#### Pre-examination requirements

**Patient**

- Fasting for **3 hours or more**
- Lying on the examination bed for **5 minutes** before the examination (to allow the body to rest)

**Operator**

- Duly trained by Echosens (or its local representative)

**Device**

- Probes are calibrated

### Examination room set-up

**Operator**

- Facing the screen on a height-adjustable stool

**Patient**

- Lying flat on the examination bed
- Right arm under the head
- “Banana shaped” position

### Probe selection criteria

Ensure the probe corresponds to the patient’s body type:

- For adults choosing between **M+** and **XL+**, follow the automatic probe selection tool displayed in real time, based on the **Probe to Liver Capsule Distance (PCD)** (not on BMI).
- **Warning:** Selecting XL+ only when M+ examination fails is not correct — follow the automated probe advice.

### Examination reliability criteria

**LSM reliability criteria**

- At least **10 measurements** at the same spot with one single probe
- Liver stiffness **IQR/Median ratio ≤ 30%** when the final median stiffness result exceeds **7.1 kPa**

**CAP reliability criteria**

- Sufficient ultrasound attenuation measurements acquired (CAP progression bar reaches **100%**)

### Set-up of system

[**IRH NOTE:** Fibroscan machine has a *Research Mode*. We should be using this. Allows entry of ID number. Explore functionality]{.highlight}

| Step | Action |
|:-:|--------|
| 1 | Place FibroScan near the exam table and ensure the necessary probes are connected. If not charged, plug the FibroScan into an electrical outlet. When charged, it can operate from battery. |
| 2 | Turn on the FibroScan by pressing the **Power** button on the back of the system. Allow time for it to boot up. |
| 3 | Log into the system as an **Operator** or **FibroScan Admin**. |
|  | **If first-time use:** USER1 for “Operator”; FSCONF1 for “FibroScan Admin”. Check the user manual for password configuration. |

### Examination

| Step | Action |
|:-:|--------|
| 1 | Touch **New Examination** (center of the screen) to start. |
| 2 | Complete patient information fields as required by your site. Minimum requirement before starting is **Last Name**. Touch the **Play** icon to proceed. |
| 3 | Complete new examination fields as required by your site (including **Examination type** and Guided VCTE™ as ON/OFF). Touch the **Play** icon to proceed. |

### Localisation phase

Search for the center of the liver by:

- Using **Ultrasound™ mode**
- Observing the **LSM** and **CAP™** indicators
- Performing measurements in different intercostal positions

### Examination phase

**a) AutoScan**

AutoScan can be initiated by ensuring:

- Recommended probe is being used
- LSM indicator is **orange**
- CAP™ indicator is **blue**
- Press and hold the button on the probe for a few seconds to activate AutoScan (acquires **10 valid LSM measurements**)

**b) Manual measurements**

Manual measurements can be initiated by ensuring:

- Recommended probe is being used
- LSM indicator is **orange**
- CAP™ indicator is **blue**
- Press the button to acquire individual measurements

### Deleting measurements

To delete measurements:

- Touch the **Trash Can** icon on the top right-hand corner of any measurement. This selects that measurement and all preceding measurements. Confirm deletion in the pop-up.
- Use the icon to delete all measurements except for the last 10.

### Completing the exam

#### Quality assurance checklist

- At least **10 valid** measurements, all performed at the same spot
- High quality elastograms with linear and parallel margin
- CAP™ progression bar is **100%** before removing probe
- IQR/Median Ratio is **≤30%** when there are 10 LSM measurements

To save and end the examination, touch the **Square** icon in the lower right-hand corner of the screen.

### Data management

| Step | Action |
|:-:|--------|
| 1 | To export the scan, touch the **Square with the Arrow** icon on the lower tool bar. |
| 2 | In the pop-up window, select appropriate options for **Export format** and **De-identified**. |
| 3 | To print, a printer must be installed. Ensure the **Printer** icon is not faded, then press it to print. |

### Cleaning and powering down

| Step | Action |
|:-:|--------|
| 1 | Clean the probe and system as outlined in the user manual using approved disinfectants (list available via the referenced website/QR code). |
| 2 | To power off, touch the **Shutdown** icon. Once shut down, unplug (if required) and safely store the FibroScan. |

### Reference note

This FibroScan SOP is based on the **Echosens training manual**.
